newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends mixed, bearish crop data.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends mixed, bearish crop data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Pre-weekend selling and a bearish crop report from Ivan Wong dragged prices down at the close. But some covering was seen at lower levels. Trading was volatile. Gains in Chicago soyoil helped prices earlier. Nov contract seen trading between 1,230 and 1,265 next week.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Thin trade and prices were steady.
He said end-August stocks are estimated at 785,000 tonnes compared with trade expectation of 750,000 to 755,000 tonnes.
Morning prices have firmed on soyoil's gains in Chicago overnight and technical buying after third month November futures broke the 1,250 ringgit resistance level.
The contract closed unchanged at Thursday's 1,243 ringgit ($497.99) a tonne, after trading between 1,241 and 1,257.
Traders said they expect the contract to trade between 1,230 and 1,265 ringgit next week.
Trading was volatile and turnover was 2,127 lots.
Lack of strong demand also eased the market, traders said, expecting fresh tenders from India and Pakistan next week. The market is also awaiting demand from China.
Among physicals, interest was among nearby crude palm oil with Sep (south) crude palm oil quoting sellers at 1,260 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,260 to 1,255. Sep (south) saw bids at 1,250.
Sep (central) was offered at 1,250 with bids at 1,240. Sep (north) saw offers at 1,240 and bids at 1,230.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,270 ringgit with bids at 1,255. Oct (central) saw offers at 1,260 and bids at 1,245 and Nov (south) at 1,275 with bids at 1,260.
In refined products, Sep RBD palmoil was offered at $535 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $537.50.

Sep palm olein saw offers at $575, Oct at $570 and Nov/Dec at $560. Sep RBD pam stearin was offered at $425 and Oct at $427.50. Sep/Oct palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $342.50. - Tan Lee Lee (603-2308911) ($1=2.4960 ringgit)
